mechanism: Bisacodyl may increase intestinal motility and reduce primaquine absorption, potentially decreasing antimalarial efficacy, while primaquine's hemolytic effects in G6PD-deficient patients may be exacerbated by GI irritation from bisacodyl.
action: Separate administration by at least 2-4 hours; monitor for adequate antimalarial response and counsel on G6PD status before primaquine use.
